about_the_game:
Welcome to the gig economy... of the undead.

In Checkout Blitz: The Shopping Dead, you're not a hero — you're a gig shopper on a deadline. Battle through collapsing stores overrun by zombies, fill out absurd shopping lists, and punch anything that gets in your way — including your competition.

Whether you go solo, team up in co-op, or square off in versus mode, every run is a chaotic dash through randomized store layouts filled with hazards, enemies, and power-ups. Fight to survive, climb the class ranks, and earn that sweet, sweet retail cash.

Just remember: dead shoppers don’t get refunds.

Features

  • Arcade Roguelike Mayhem – Every run is different: random stores, item lists, hazards, and enemy spawns keep you on your toes.

  • Punch-First Shopping – Fend off zombies, dodge traps, and knock out rival players to finish your list first.

  • 3 Game Modes – Play solo, share a list in co-op, or race to win in versus mode.

  • Shopper Class Progression – Level up through 5 shopper ranks with permanent upgrades.

  • Earn. Upgrade. Repeat. – Your shopper rank persists across runs, unlocking higher stats and bigger payouts.

  • Power-Ups & Pickups – Unlock boosts like speed carts, cash multipliers, and weird gimmicks.

  • Full Gamepad Support – Optimized for couch play with local co-op and versus modes.

  • Achievements & Replay Value – Unlock ridiculous milestones and chase high scores with randomized runs.

  • Retro Flair – Vibrant vector-pixel visuals, snappy soundtrack, and arcade-style presentation.
